basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Inner Richmond across from Golden Gate Park, this charming Edwardian home offers a blend of space and timeless character. South-facing with expansive windows, the home is filled with natural light and park views, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Newly refinished hardwood floors and fresh paint highlight the airy living, while the traditional floor plan provides timeless comfort. The spacious living room, complete with a fireplace and perfect alcove for a home office, flows into a formal dining room ideal for gatherings. Two well-sized bedrooms plus a large sunroom - flexible as a third bedroom, playroom, or a 2nd office - are complemented by 1.5 baths. Bonus room on the ground level offers additional versatility to fit your lifestyle. One-car parking, ample storage, and dedicated laundry. Shared backyard provides a serene setting for outdoor relaxation or entertaining. With Golden Gate Park as your front yard, enjoy nearby landmarks such as the DeYoung Museum, Academy of Sciences, Rose Garden, and more. Stroll to the Clement Street farmers market, explore neighborhood favorites on Balboa, Geary, and Clement, or head to Ocean Beach for a day by the water. Convenient access to MUNI, driving routes, and bike paths makes commuting a breeze.
